quotes.author: Mark Ingle
quotes.text: I had a great time fishing with Blake! It was my first time in the Keys, and even though it was cold and windy, Blake was able to adapt. We ended up with 13 nice trout and several jacks.

quotes.author: Troy Selover
quotes.text: Blake has taken us out fishing multiple times and always does a great job. He works hard to find good spots where fish are biting and makes the experience fun and informative.
